Instr00C845.name: Jump stub and demo input script
summary: $00C845: JMP to the Yoshi check at the end of Mario physics (CODE_00CD8F).
DATA_00C848: input script for EnterCastleAni, pairs of (controller byte, frame count), $FF ends it. Bit 6 of a byte has a special meaning (see code).

EnterCastleAni.name: Mario animation A: scripted walk, level end
summary: Mario animation $0A (Enter Castle): Mario plays back the controller script at DATA_00C848 and the normal physics run on it; any new button press, or $FF in the script, ends it and sets the next game mode.
$00C915: level end handler for the end-of-level timer [$1493] (goal, switch palace, cutscene triggers), jumped to from ResetAni.
Phase 1 walks Mario right while the timer runs, then starts the iris-out; phase 2 (CODE_00C9AF) shows the peace pose, closes the iris and selects the next game mode and [$0DD5] exit type.

Instr00C9A4.name: Jump to Mario physics, cutscene level list
summary: $00C9A4: JMP to CODE_00CD24 (Mario physics). DATA_00C9A7: level numbers ([$13BF]) that start cutscenes 1-8 when beaten.

SetMarioPeaceImg.name: Peace pose and iris-out effect
summary: SetMarioPeaceImg: sets Mario frame $26 (peace sign), $14 on Yoshi.
$00CA3E: starts the iris-out by setting [$1433] = $F0. $00CA44: each frame while [$1433] is non-zero, shrinks the radius by 4 and rebuilds the circle window.
$00CA6D: A = radius change. Builds a per-scanline window table (left, right) at $04A0 for HDMA channel 7, centered on Mario, using the table at [$04]/[$06]; sets [$0D9F] = $80.

s00CB12.name: Data: iris shape tables
summary: Circle half-width table (128 entries, then $00) followed by a second shape table (probably the keyhole).

s00CC14.name: Iris half-width lookup
summary: Computes the half-width of the iris window at vertical distance [$01] from its center, for radius [$1433], using the hardware divider and multiplier.
Parameters: [$01]: distance, [$04]/[$06]: shape tables. Returns: [$02] and [$03]: half-widths, A = [$02].

ResetAni.name: Mario animation 0: normal per-frame handling
summary: Mario animation 0: the normal per-frame Mario routine. Debug mode toggle (unreachable), end-of-level handler, L/R scrolling, lock timer, physics dispatch (normal, boss room/keyhole, climbing, swimming, flying), pipe pose and Yoshi pose.
Returns with the Mario frame in $13E0 set when relevant.

OnYoshiAnimations.name: Yoshi poses and L/R scrolling
summary: Table of Mario poses on Yoshi, then CODE_00CDAD (picks the pose from the Yoshi tongue timer [$14A3] and ducking) and CODE_00CDDD (hold L or R to scroll the screen).

ScrollScreen.name: L/R screen scrolling
summary: Holding L or R for $10 frames moves the static camera region [$142A] toward the left or right limit, freezing sprites while it moves, with a sound effect.

s00CE79.name: Data: Mario slide poses
summary: Frame numbers $2A-$2F, and the slope sliding table indexed by slope and direction.

s00CE99.name: Data: spin jump tables
summary: DATA_00CE99: frame values, DATA_00CEA1: Mario facing during a spin jump, DATA_00CEA9: cape images.

s00CEB1.name: Cape image update (air)
summary: Called from ResetAni with JSL. Updates the cape image [$13DF] and its animation timer [$14A2] depending on Mario being in the air, falling, swimming or running; continues in the next chunk with the spin jump code.

MarioAnimAir.name: Cape update: on ground
summary: On the ground: X speed non-zero goes to the speed based timer, else Y = 8.

MrioNtInWtr.name: Cape update: step image down
summary: Decreases the cape image toward 2 and ends in the shared store of [$13DF]/[$14A2] at CODE_00CF0A.
